review.why: Designs banners for social, ads, website heroes and print in HTML and CSS, with several art directions, safe zones and PNG export.
review.summary: Gathers purpose, size, content, brand and style, researches references if browsing is allowed, picks two or three art directions, then builds each banner at exact dimensions in HTML and CSS with safe-zone, two-typeface and contrast rules. Visuals come from supplied assets, CSS or an optional image tool, with no text in generated images. It exports PNGs and checks size and crop.
strengths: Self-contained: falls back to CSS visuals when no tools are available
Concrete rules: safe zone, two typefaces, 4.5:1 contrast, single call to action
Says PNG export is pending rather than naming a tool that is not installed
cautions: Sizes and styles depend on a bundled reference not read here
Banner design only: not video or full websites
Image generation needs a separately provided capability
